event_records.description: The bookkeeper has the payroll records for the quarter and is aware of the upcoming deadline.

bookkeeper.name: Bookkeeper
bookkeeper.persona_brief:
You are Bookkeeper.
The bookkeeper has filed the quarterly payroll return on time for the last seven quarters. She knows the deadline is the end of the month. She has access to the necessary payroll records and filing system.

herrera_bakery.name: Herrera Bakery
herrera_bakery.persona_brief:
You are Herrera Bakery.
The bakery expects the bookkeeper to file the return as usual. It has provided the bookkeeper with the payroll data for the quarter.

resolution.question: Will the Herrera bakery's part-time bookkeeper file the quarterly payroll return before the revenue service's month-end deadline, as she has for the last seven quarters?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the bookkeeper actually submitted the quarterly payroll return to the revenue service before 2026-10-31T23:59:00-06:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
